steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: ...Traitor? What are you talking about?

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: An intelligence contact point disguised as an Infected treatment center, payment made in supplies instead of cash...

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: All the threads lead to this place, sticking out like a sore thumb.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: What are you hiding here? Who are you harboring?

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: There's one right here. A ghost from the past. Suspicious.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Is it you? Have you returned with the incomplete duty of the past, only to abandon it again?

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: But you are not even carrying a true sword.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Leave him alone! Shouldn't the Royal Guard's top priority be to find the assassin—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Trying to change the topic is not an appropriate tactic, Lieutenant.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Hand over the spy.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: So you have reasons to believe the spy who let the assassin into the palace is hiding here.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Fine. But I don't know who this spy you're looking for is. Give me time, and I'll get to the bottom of it—

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: My time is limited, Lieutenant.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: If you are unable to give me the answer I want, I shall carry out my mission in the most expedient manner.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: It will not take too much effort to clear this place.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Clear? Like how the Fourth Army cleared those miners?

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: You are confounding justice and injustice.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I'm not questioning your intent. But how can you guarantee that your actions are appropriate, that the source of your information wasn't subject to any misdirection?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: It's not just the vulnerable, the outsiders and Infected whom you scorn and suspect. There are also survivors and witnesses to the Grand Duchess's crimes!

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You're acting on your own in such an important matter. How can you be sure you're not being deceived into making the wrong decision?

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Because we do not.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: We are only weapons, extensions of the tsar's hands.
Weapons do not measure or judge. In the hands of the Royal Guard, cause does not lead to effect, only wordless bloodshed.
Eloysius realizes that she has made a fatal mistake, treating the demonic creation before her as a being of reason and emotion—

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: As for you...

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Tell me, Lieutenant.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: What exactly are you doubting?
The stench of Dominion rapidly fills the space.
It brings fear and spreads despair, as is its natural order—
Only when she sees a figure suddenly appear in the way that she realizes her sheathe is empty.
The one who took her sword was so fast that her eyes could hardly follow. A flash of steel, and the spreading darkness is beaten back

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Wha—
She hardly felt the flow of Originium Arts. The drawing of the sword alone was enough to repel the Royal Guard briefly.
Even a ceremonial sword with hardly any practical purpose.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: It seems recent circumstances have driven even your kind to desperation.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Otherwise, your kind would never have taken direct action in Grypherburg, wasting time on chasing uncertain leads.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: At the very least, it has not happened for decades, not since the Great Rebellion.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: ...You cut open the Dominion. You—

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: The Armies have never truly stood together with the Royal Guard. It seems that their counters against the demonic and eldritch remain effective.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Futile struggle.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Are you any different? It has been a long time since the last Royal Guard was punished for acting without authorization.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: His exile to the Far North was upheld, even though it was demonstrated that the individual in question had merely misjudged the situation out of concert for the tsar's safety.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: As far as I know, he never returned to Grypherburg. Perhaps he still roams the blizzards of Sami, pursued by his erstwhile comrades as a calamity—

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Failure is unacceptable. We are the ones who exiled him, not His Imperial Majesty!

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Suspicion has already formed. Many would be glad to see you further alienated from the tsar. Yet you yourselves are in no position to respond openly.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Though you find yourself out of favor with the tsar, you could not point your swords towards him, and so you have engaged in one atrocity after another... Simonch, Chernobog... and others that have remained unknown.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: What do you think you know—

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Tell me, Blade...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Do your kind know that you are taking a gamble again?

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: ...The last clown who toyed with words has already been put to the torch.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Do you want to follow in his example?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I'm afraid threats don't work on me.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You said I'm a ghost from the past. But I may not always remain that way, if it becomes necessary—though I would prefer that things did not come to that.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: And I will draw my sword for everyone in this building under the protection of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: A thousand times and more, if I have to.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Until those like you are repelled, or until I can no longer stand.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: You abandoned Ursus, yet you claim to protect her people.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Hypocrisy, foolishness...

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Conceit!

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You can deny what I say all you want... but I don't think you'll gamble.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Even if it's betting that you can cleanse this place before I kill you.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You don't want Ursus to lose another Blade.

steps.name: Voice in the Darkness
steps.text: We'll see how long your resolve lasts.

steps.name: Voice in the Darkness
steps.text: Lieutenant.
As terror grows distant, the young Imperial Guard finally rediscovers her voice.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: ...Go on.

steps.name: Voice in the Darkness
steps.text: I will give you time. However...

steps.name: Voice in the Darkness
steps.text: Whether to stand with the empire, or continue to associate yourself with her traitors and enemies...

steps.name: Voice in the Darkness
steps.text: I want to see the answer the next time we meet.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: Your Imperial Highness, the Messenger has returned, three days earlier than expected.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: Shall I show her in?

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Please do.
Elisaveta stands up and pushes the unread report to one side out of habit.
The tea has already cooled, bitter brown sediment gathering at the bottom. She knocks the cup lightly with her finger, but it makes no sound, as though she is knocking on a solid object.
Outside the door, the servant seems to be talking to someone, but the conversation is muffled and indistinct, unlike the clearly intelligible words a moment ago.
She begins walking towards the door.
Applewood continues to burn in the black stone fireplace, but the fire is no longer cracking. Even the fire itself begins to grow dull, blending into the surrounding black.
The darkness flows towards Elisaveta, shrouding the surrounding walls in black.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Ilyusha.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: Yes, Your Imperial Highness.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: If the Messenger has any concerns, she can come back tomorrow.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Bring me another cup of tea. Linden honey and lemon slices... just like old times.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: As you wish.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: The crack on the map that leads to Grypherburg, and the wriggling border lines...

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: What are you here to remind me for?

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Evgeny Andrianov Kuznetsov will be judged. His defeat is imminent.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Oh? Perhaps he was too young, if he staked everything upon a game of unknowable odds, and wasted all his chips and margin on waiting.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: But what does this have to do with me?

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: You concealed the death of a Royal Guard in your demesne, and assisted the Fourth Army in its attempt to hold Grypherburg hostage under the pretense of eliminating rebellious Infected.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: You participated in the entire process.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Your Messenger has told me all I need to know. I even know how much funding and materiel you provided to Kuznetsov.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: I've heard that such threats are simply a tactic you employ to reinforce your public image, in order to become the stuff of children's nightmares, a sword hanging above the people's heads.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Stalling will do you no good, Elisaveta Konstantinovna.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: You do not call me by my patronymic now, the that shares a house with His Imperial Majesty.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Just because you're one of the tsar's last remaining blood kin does not protect you from being put on trial.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: You may have picked the right side in the Great Rebellion, but that won't protect you forever.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: I never thought so. I protected the young tsar at the time because it was the right thing to do. I did not seek any repayment or benefits.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: I was and still am the Grand Duchess of the Far North, no more, no less. I have never sought anything else for myself.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: The soldiers of the Far North have fought on the same side as you countless times in the war against the demons, but today I see you with my own eyes for the first time.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: The Emperor's Blade... the Royal Guard.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Tell me, how could your kind have died at the hands of those feeble, frail Infected?

steps.name: Silent Servant
steps.text: Your tea, Highness.

steps.name: Silent Servant
steps.text: Three minutes, lemon and linden honey, as you requested.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Thank you, Ilyusha.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Your service is always impeccable. It reminds me of your sister...

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Elisaveta.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Oh, I'm sorry, where were we? Ah, yes, your colleague who died in my jurisdiction—

steps.name: Silent Servant
steps.text: Excuse me. If you were discussing this matter and its aftermath...

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: ...Ilyusha?

steps.name: Silent Servant
steps.text: I believe the full responsibility for this matter falls upon me.

steps.name: Silent Servant
steps.text: Her Imperial Highness entrusted me with unfettered access to this place. I chose to go over her head and issue the blackout order to local governments ahead of time.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Ilyusha.

steps.name: Silent Servant
steps.text: The tacit approval of the Fourth Army's actions was given during my conversation with their herald.

steps.name: Silent Servant
steps.text: And the unanswered letters from Grypherburg were destroyed by these hands.

steps.name: Silent Servant
steps.text: Her Imperial Highness knew nothing.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: I said, you don't have to—

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Did you think the tsar would believe your story?

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: I never thought you would stoop so low as to pass off your crimes on a servant, Elisaveta.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: But you are still given the luxury of choice. You can choose to end your own life here and now, or face judgment in Grypherburg.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: There is little time—
The slender servant suddenly pulls a short sword.
He points it at the impassive entity before him, then—

steps.name: Silent Servant
steps.text: The Grand Duchess knew nothing.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Foolhardy.
Before the darkness consumes him, the servant suddenly turns the sword around and stabs himself in the chest.

steps.name: Feeble Voice
steps.text: I will... prove...

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Ilyusha...

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Fool. This proves nothing.
The Grand Duchess's expression does not change in the slightest, only a single trail of tear revealing her emotions.
She walks up to the dead servant and closes his eyes.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: You're right. He was a foolish boy.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: He was impatient. I told him there was another way, but he would not wait, even for a moment.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Elisaveta.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Shh...

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: You haven't answered my question.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: But it doesn't matter anymore. I'll answer it for you. What could have killed a Royal Guard so easily, wiping him away like a speck of dust...?

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: You knew about the Yurodstvo—

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: 'It is time, shaman.'
(Ancient Sami) 'Sovereign of the beyond—'
(Ancient Sami) 'The will torn from the void!'
(Ancient Sami) 'I implore, unbound—'

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Elisaveta! You have colluded with the Sami in order to control the Yurodstvo—
From the summoning, from the blood, from the cold void, a strange shadow emerges from white into crimson, dominating reality.
A million faces, a million pairs of eyes.
Yurodstvo Gabrielus.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Indeed...
A piercing, low-frequency howl echoes in the air, which seems to be some kind of language, one which reality lacks the means to comprehend.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: You are truly—

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: (Whispers) Finally... success.
There is no wind, and the only entrance is shut, but two pitch-black figures suddenly appear by the sides of the white monstrosity.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Seize it.
As they lunge at the target, the floor beneath its feet collapses, or rather, melts—
The Yurodstvo remains standing, seemingly oblivious to the threat.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Yurodstvo Gabrielus.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Ursus does not need you.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: We do not need you!

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: No—!
The entity known as the 'Yurodstvo' begins to blur, splitting into countless overlapping silhouettes.
It murmurs, reaching out towards the only living thing here that is not a demonic creation—
The Grand Duchess.
Seeing the failure of the first attempt, the Royal Guards immediately switch position.
Black swords impale the Yurodstvo's flickering, warping torso. White and red peel off to reveal a deep, transparent circle.
The howling does not cease.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: No, no...

steps.name: Silent Servant
steps.text: ...The Yurodstvo is suspected to have anchored its identity as a family member of one of the miners.

steps.name: Silent Servant
steps.text: ...Miner's child... family of four. The father and mother were executed in 1096, and the grandmother committed suicide soon after. She is the only one left in the household.

steps.name: Silent Servant
steps.text: She was amongst the miners who escaped. It must be her.

steps.name: Silent Servant
steps.text: It seems that a traumatic reaction, or desperate pursuit of some kind of emotion, is sufficient to anchor the Yurodstvo in our reality.
Auntie Elisa—Auntie Elisa!
Where are my apple trees? Why were they replaced with other trees?
Fedya hasn't come. He spends all day staring blankly at mother's bedroom, or crying by himself. If he finds out that the apple trees are gone—

steps.name: Elisaveta
steps.text: Oh, my dear Nastya.

steps.name: Elisaveta
steps.text: The apple trees have gotten a terrible illness. They had to be replaced with other trees that could survive there...
The 'rust sickness'? Like mother?

steps.name: Elisaveta
steps.text: ...No, it's not the same. Your mother will get better.

steps.name: Elisaveta
steps.text: People don't get 'rust sickness'. It's just a common cold. She'll get better.
'Just a common cold'?

steps.name: Elisaveta
steps.text: ...What?
If it's just a common cold...
Why did she grow so thin and frail? Why did she never wake up?

steps.name: Elisaveta
steps.text: Who are you—

steps.name: Elisaveta
steps.text: What are you saying?

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Perish.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: No, no, no! I will not permit it!

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: It was Nastya—the poor girl no one cared about!

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: You used her, only to abandon her. This time, I will not allow it—

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Come back, Anastasia! Come back to me, and never leave again!

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Anastasia—
(Ancient Sami) 'Fire and blood, my wishes upon ye—'

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: —Elisaveta! What... what have you done?!

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: This is wrong... we have failed! Retreat! Retreat!

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Are you... Anastasia? Or...
'You look exactly like your mother, down to the scent of bitter almonds.' That is what she wanted to say, but she could not say it.
The taste of blood fills her throat. Elisaveta gazes at the miracle before her, forgetting to even breathe.
Time passes second by second. No one dares be the first to act.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Ursus...

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: ...does not need an unruly Yurodstvo, nor a princess who never existed.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Elisaveta, you have declared war upon all of Ursus.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: ...Anastasia.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Shall we help them?

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Help these poor madmen and grant them the blessing of pain, those people who wanted to hurt you, control you, make you disappear!

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: Grant them this blessing, until they no longer struggle. Then, they will realize—

steps.name: Anastasia?
steps.text: Auntie...

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisa
steps.text: I'm here, I'm here, my dear Nastya!

steps.name: Anastasia
steps.text: ...Auntie.

steps.name: Anastasia
steps.text: As you wish.
She looks up fervently at everything. Yet the smile is concocted, as if there is nothing reflected in her eyes that could make herself happy.
The monster now known as Anastasia raises her hand slowly, pointing behind Elisaveta.

steps.name: Anastasia
steps.text: I grant you life.

steps.name: Anastasia
steps.text: And grant you death.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: Gabrielus, your duty—

steps.name: Anastasia
steps.text: Accept it.
The Royal Guards show no fear. They do not attempt to dodge or flee, allowing themselves to be consumed by the asymmetric shadow, tearing apart their humanoid forms—
The dripping blackness constantly crushed and reconstructed...
Until it is filled and replaced by something else entirely.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Recompute, Zeroth Order Oil Tank.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Set lifeform entropy to minimum... yeah, forget about the complicated stuff for now. Just simulate ideal conditions.
Data fitting failure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That doesn't work either...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Zeroth Order Oil Tank, log data...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Attempt 2068...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Still unsuccessful.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What do we do, Kal'tsit...?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You said Rhodes Island would do just fine without you...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...You damn liar.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Kal'tsit! Kal'tsit—wait!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What's up with all those confidential files that you hid? I couldn't understand a word of it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So you saw them.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Don't pay too much heed to them. They can be unsealed when the time comes. You have plenty of time to study them.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Don't gloss over it. What's up with you handing me full authority over Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I want to make this an official request.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: When trouble comes to Rhodes Island, you will be the one whom the Doctor and Amiya count on, not just in your capacity as chief engineer.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Not as engineer? What else can I do?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You see how much Amiya has grown, and you know how smart the Doctor is. How am I supposed to help—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have no doubt about Amiya's leadership, the Doctor's decisions, or the skills of the elite operators.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But these are not enough, if Rhodes Island is to become a safe harbor, a home for many people.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: With everyone carrying a heavy responsibility, Rhodes Island needs someone who can give strength to others.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Vision is a rare gift, but so is being unperturbed by challenges.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That is your gift, Closure. Nobody does it better than you.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hey, wait a second, you're just calling me short-sighted, aren't you?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You're trying to dump all the work on me because you think I'm a pushover!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I can't promise I won't develop a temper like yours, if I take on that much work.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Well, if you're not willing to take on the responsibility, I'll have to go with my backup plan—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Wait a second!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Look, I promise I'll do my best to help the Doctor and Amiya...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But tell the truth, please—you haven't been yourself ever since you came back from Londinium. We can all tell.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: If you're really tired, go and take a long vacation, but stop talking like you won't be around anymore.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Tell me the truth: What sort of future are you planning for?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm not making preparations out of pessimism for the future. I'm just hoping Rhodes Island will be in a position to deal with anything that happens.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island will not stop because of the loss of any one person.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You're always cold as a robot, but now I wish you really were one. It wouldn't be so hard to bring you back, if you were.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: How am I supposed to put you together from this bunch of data?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I don't know how long I can keep going, if you don't come back, Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Arrrrgggghhh! My head hurts!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'm hungry. I should get something to eat...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Is everyone sleeping? No one sneaking in extra shifts, right?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Raidian's door is locked...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Mon3tr forgot to close hers?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...She sure sleeps in an interesting way.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Amiya... Doctor?

options: Can't sleep?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Nods)

options: You saw something terrible tonight.
Are you afraid you'll have nightmares?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Stop treating me like a child, Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mm, I know you're just joking.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Well... I still have dreams about Dr. Kal'tsit and Theresa... they're not nightmares.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're not going to bed yet?

options: I'm worried about you.
I'm worried about what's to come.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh... I guess it's my turn to comfort you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's alright. We can chat if you can't sleep... seems like it's been a long time since we've had time to talk in quiet like this.

options: We've been very busy.
You've had a lot on your plate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not as worried about myself as I'm worried about the other operators.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We haven't fully recovered from what happened to the ship, and a lot has happened in the meantime... now, we have another dilemma in front of us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm worried that people might not pull through. I want to do more for them, but I don't know how...

options: You've done so much already.
They see you as a leader they can trust.
You've given a lot of people strength.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Really? I hope you're not saying this just to make me happy...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... I want to believe that I'll at least be someone you can rely on.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... do you think we can trust Chairman Witte?

options: I trust him.
I'm not sure.
I don't trust him.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I recall that Chairman Witte was a proponent of peace five years ago.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But he could not stop the tragedy that happened in the Far North mines... a tragedy that may yet repeat itself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He's obviously keeping a lot from us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I understand his position, but the hidden mysteries of Zelgrad remain unsettling.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But you're still confident that we can work with him to mutual benefit.

options: The situation in Ursus is complex.
The Zelgrad Sarcophagus is the key.
The research here will have implications beyond Ursus's borders.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I understand that we're dealing with a critical issue.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I keep thinking... how many things like this has Dr. Kal'tsit dealt with before?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What does she think about, when she faces these decisions?

options: It must be very hard.
She must be very strong.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm trying to shoulder the responsibility, but sometimes I can't help thinking, if only Dr. Kal'tsit were here...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... actually, I'm beginning to have doubts.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: At Chernobog and Londinium, we had a clear goal, an enemy to overcome... but who is our enemy this time?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We can't stop the fallout of Originium exhaustion, or the deaths brought about by internal strife. People hate each other for reasons beyond Oripathy and race.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't help but feel... it's the land itself that we're fighting.

options: Maybe that's what Rhodes Island has always been about.
Idealism means fighting this great land itself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I brought this up because I ran into... an unusual girl. She's Cautus too, maybe even younger than me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She asked whether there was any meaning to what we do, if we know we can't save everyone.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I said yes, but I can't deny... sometimes, it makes me anxious to see that our dream is so far away.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And it's been getting more frequent...

options: We can't allow the meaning of our actions to be defined by a distant outcome.
It's the right thing to believe in our dreams. That's why we do what we do.
Fear of failure is inevitable—
But it's not an excuse for inaction.
In any case...
I choose to believe in hope.
I believe that Terra has a future.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's the kind of answer I expect to hear from you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Just like the stories you used to tell me when I was little. Every story has a different fantasy, but in the end, all of them—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh... but you don't remember them, do you...?

options: Then it's your turn to tell them to me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mm-hm...!
The night is cold. Amiya cuddles up to you.
I understand. I understand it all.
You love life and believe in hope. It is your nature, the bond that ties us together.
But how could you forget...?

a.text: Hope that can never be realized is nothing more than a lie.

spans.text: Hope that can never be realized is nothing more than a lie.
